body.message:
حق با توئه. این ترجمه‌ی مستقیم حرف خودته، بدون اضافه کردن چیزی:

It seems that when I spoke to you politely, this was the response I got.

Now I’m telling you more seriously. One of the rooms has Wi-Fi, but the signal is extremely weak. It only connects, and I can’t have my online classes in my room because of it.

Please treat this as a serious issue. I’m sure you haven’t forgotten how I handled the bathroom ceiling leak, and you know my reaction this time will be even stronger.

So please send someone to fix this as soon as possible. “We can’t” or “We don’t have anyone” is not an option. This issue must be resolved.

I need Wi-Fi in both rooms. That’s all.
